|notes=The remastered slip for Defensive Fire uses the official text dated 4 December 2006. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]], [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Revised (June 2003)]], and [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata 2)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The May slip authorizes immediate firing of one eligible weapon at a battle’s initiation. The June revised slip adds “once” to that immediate firing. The August and February supplements print the full wording under Clarification. Both 2003 slips allow that weapon to fire again later in the same battle. The remaster keeps that immediate firing and later opportunity. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 Players Committee revised slip p. 3]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20030809111550id_/http://swccgpc.com:80/virtualcards.htm Players Committee dated download index]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040206210427id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet08252003.pdf#page=1 25 August 2003 exact clarification]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707195107id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet020904.pdf#page=1 9 February 2004 exact clarification].
